html:
[Hypothesis]

采用 56-df-outermost-residual-chain 的正交系统与 \(\operatorname{ResidualChain}_R,\operatorname{OuterResidualChain}_R\)；\(\operatorname{OccStrategy}_R,\operatorname{InfStrategy}_R\) 见 56-df-occurrence-reduction-strategy。两个路径谓词分别以 \(\boldsymbol s\in T^{\mathbb N}\)、\(\boldsymbol u\in\mathcal E_R^{\mathbb N}\) 为局部参数；两个策略谓词独立以 \(S\subseteq\operatorname{Step}_R\) 为局部参数，其无限序列由内部量词绑定。

[Assertion]

[Remark]

公平排除全部无限残余链；最外公平只排除持续最外的无限残余链。定义首先作用于具体无限归约，再对策略允许的所有无限路径量化。有限路径没有无限链，故不另编码其公平性。仅知道项序列不足以判定这些性质：必须知道每步实际收缩的红项身份，见原书Example 9.3.2(ii)。

本节点没有把“最外公平”误写为每次必须收缩最外红项，也没有把它误写为所有无限次成为最外的红项都须消失；这两种性质都与书中定义不同。定义本身不保证正规化，正交性在后续证明中起实质作用。

links.excerpt: 采用 [[56-df-outermost-residual-chain]] 的正交系统与 $\operatorname{ResidualChain}_R,\operatorname{OuterResidualChain}_R$；$\operatorname{OccStrategy}_R,\operatorname{InfStrategy}_R$ 见 [[56-df-occurrence-reduction-strategy]]。两个路径谓词分别以 $\boldsymbol s\in T^{\mathbb N}$、$\boldsymbol u\in\mathcal E_R^{\mathbb N}$ 为局部参数；两个策略谓词独立以 $S\subseteq\operatorname{Step}_R$ 为局部参数，其无限序列由内部量词绑定。

math.tex:
\operatorname{FairPath}_R(\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u)\iff
\operatorname{InfRed}_R(\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u)\land
\neg\exists i\in\mathbb N\;\exists\boldsymbol c\in\mathcal E_R^{\mathbb N}\;
\operatorname{ResidualChain}_R(\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u,i,\boldsymbol c).

\operatorname{OuterFairPath}_R(\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u)\iff
\operatorname{InfRed}_R(\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u)\land
\neg\exists i\in\mathbb N\;\exists\boldsymbol c\in\mathcal E_R^{\mathbb N}\;
\operatorname{OuterResidualChain}_R(\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u,i,\boldsymbol c).

\operatorname{FairOccStrategy}_R(S)\iff
\operatorname{OccStrategy}_R(S)\land
\forall\boldsymbol s\in T^{\mathbb N}\;\forall\boldsymbol u\in\mathcal E_R^{\mathbb N}\;
\bigl(\operatorname{InfStrategy}_R(S,\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u)\Rightarrow\operatorname{FairPath}_R(\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u)\bigr).

\operatorname{OuterFairOccStrategy}_R(S)\iff
\operatorname{OccStrategy}_R(S)\land
\forall\boldsymbol s\in T^{\mathbb N}\;\forall\boldsymbol u\in\mathcal E_R^{\mathbb N}\;
\bigl(\operatorname{InfStrategy}_R(S,\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u)\Rightarrow\operatorname{OuterFairPath}_R(\boldsymbol s,\boldsymbol u)\bigr).

backlinks.excerpt: 固定正交系统，$\boldsymbol s\in T^{\mathbb N}$、$\boldsymbol u\in\mathcal E_R^{\mathbb N}$；$s_0\in\mathcal N_R$。$\operatorname{OuterFairPath}_R$ 及持续最外残余链见 [[56-df-fair-occurrence-strategy]]，$\operatorname{InfHyperNeeded}_R$ 见 [[56-df-needed-reduction-paths]]。needed存在、非needed步保持及合流分别见 [[56-thm-needed-redex-existence]]、[[56-lem-nonneeded-preserves-needed-prefix]]、[[56-thm-orthogonal-confluent]]；单步残余的红项类型与位置唯一性见 [[56-thm-orthogonal-residual-preservation]]。

固定正交系统；策略断言以 $S\subseteq\operatorname{Step}_R$ 为参数，无限路径断言的序列变量在 Assertion 内独立有界量化。$\operatorname{OuterFairPath}_R$、$\operatorname{OuterFairOccStrategy}_R$、$\operatorname{FairOccStrategy}_R$ 见 [[56-df-fair-occurrence-strategy]]；$\operatorname{NormalizingOccStrategy}_R$、$\mathrm{WNAt}$ 沿用其上游。最外公平路径转hyper-needed及其正规化分别见 [[56-lem-outermost-fair-hyper-needed]]、[[56-thm-needed-hyper-normalizing]]。
